m: वठ् (also written बठ्) cl. 1. P. वठति, to be big or fat, Dhātup. ix, 46; to be powerful or able, ib.
a: वठ् — {c1c} P. (वठति) 1 To be strong or powerful. --2 To be fat.

m: वठर mfn. stupid, dull, a fool, blockhead, Hcar.
a: वठर — a. [वठ्-अरन्] 1 Dull, stupid. --2 Wicked. --रः 1 A fool or blockhead. --2 A rogue, wicked or vile fellow. --3 A physician. --4 A water-pot.
